player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Sir Yoda''') posted a [[Light]] [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base]] list on DeckTech in June 2001.

starting.card: Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers

description: This is your basic, old-fashioned Hidden Base X-wing deck with a powerful podracing element.  Undefeated at RamapoCon 3.
cards: Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers
posted: All Wings Report In x2
notes: Cards marked [S] (start) as posted: Boonta Eve Podrace, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Yarna d'al' Gargan, Anakin's Podracer, Podrace Prep; with the Hidden Base objective these count toward the 60 (total 60).
The post says the deck went undefeated at RamapoCon 3 (one timed game, against Bastian); the wiki has no RamapoCon III event page yet (only RamapoCon II, May 2000).
Posted '[Indicator]' (the unnamed Hidden Base indicator system) is kept as written.

Posted 'Rend. Pt.' dested Rendezvous Point; 'Endor', 'Kiffex' and 'Tatooine' dested the Light Endor system, the Light Jabba's Palace Kiffex and the Light Premiere Tatooine; 'Tat Podrace Arena' dested Tatooine: Podrace Arena.

Posted 'Jedi Luke' dested Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight; 'Anakin's Saber' dested Anakin's Lightsaber; 'X-wing Cannon' dested X-wing Laser Cannon; 'Signal' dested The Signal; 'OOC & TT' dested Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated; 'Houjix & OON' dested Houjix & Out Of Nowhere; 'I Did It' dested I Did It!.
Colour headers (PURPLE, PLACES, GRAY, WHITE, GREEN, BLUE, RED) are section labels, not cards.
